trigger: bug, failing test, build error, deploy error, or runtime symptom
previous agent got stuck in repeated grep, log, or tool loops
decision needed on local investigation versus internet source check
source_of_truth: The active work target remains source of truth; official vendor sources explain external versioned behavior.
required_reads: repo source-of-truth files when the bug is in a real repo
conditional_reads: official docs, release notes, or official issue tracker for vendor/version behavior
agent error or operations knowledge packs when the symptom triggers them
allowed_writes: code, tests, docs, and status files allowed by the active work target
LLM-Wiki workflow or knowledge files only for LLM-Wiki governance or approved file-back
validation or agent result report required by the active workflow
forbidden_writes: broad grep or broad log reading without a stated hypothesis
fixes before the surviving hypothesis explains the failure anchor
boundary-changing fixes without a user, Lead, or integration-owner checkpoint
approval_gates: two probes fail without producing new information
current hypothesis cannot be stated in one sentence
next step requires broad grep, broad logs, production access, credentials, real user data, or repeated expensive validation
internet evidence and local evidence disagree
fix may change architecture, data contracts, deployment, permissions, source-of-truth boundaries, or workflow rules
evidence_before_done: verification tied to the original failure
closeout_rules: summarize live evidence if context has become noisy
checkpoint instead of continuing when uncertainty cannot be narrowed

drift_checks.description: Repo bug guidance should route through real-repo source-of-truth and claim rules before the debugging funnel.
drift_checks.remediation: Update repo bug guidance so Real Repo Work establishes source-of-truth and claims, then Bug-Fix Investigation controls probes and escalation.
